RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

An all-female panel alone is not evidence of bias; composition typically reflects available department heads, HR, or municipal leadership. 

In director-level positions, organizational fit, interview performance, and public consultation skills frequently outweigh technical degrees or years of experience. Mid-sized municipalities often prioritize community engagement capabilities for planning leadership.

Raising allegations based solely on the panel's gender composition without documented remarks or procedural violations will severely damage your professional reputation and has virtually no legal traction. Two weeks is also normal for municipal administrative delays. Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting constructive feedback framed around professional development to preserve future career opportunities.
